business_summary: SYoung Group Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of cosmetic products in China. It provides facial masks, lotions, creams, makeup, and cleansing and personal care products. The company sells its products under the Yunifang, EVIDENSDEBEAUT, PIERAUG, RVive, Yu Nifang, Big Water Drop, Little Mihu, VAA and other brands. It offers its products a through e-commerce platforms, such as Tmall, Taobao, Douyin, JD.com, Vipshop, Pinduoduo, Kuaishou, and other mainstream e-commerce platforms; offline channels, including brand-owned stores; department stores, such as SKP, Sephora, and Intime Department Stores; and supermarkets, such as Walmart and Yonghui; and beauty stores comprising Watsons, KKV, and Colorist. The company was formerly known as Yujiahui Co., Ltd. and changed its name to SYoung Group Co., Ltd. in March 2021. SYoung Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Changsha, China.
